website.name: Website
website.description: Static or dynamic website focused on content delivery
suggested_criteria: All pages render correctly across browsers
Site is responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop
Page load time meets performance targets
All links and navigation work correctly
website.suggested_must_use: Semantic HTML, responsive design, image optimization, meta tags
website.suggested_must_avoid: Inline styles for layout, blocking scripts in head, missing alt text, broken links

web_app.name: Web App
web_app.description: Interactive browser-based application or SaaS tool
suggested_criteria: Application loads and initializes without errors
Authentication and session management work correctly
web_app.suggested_must_use: Component architecture, state management, error boundaries, loading states
web_app.suggested_must_avoid: Direct DOM manipulation in frameworks, prop drilling, memory leaks in subscriptions, exposing sensitive data client-side

api.name: API
api.description: REST, GraphQL, or gRPC API service
suggested_criteria: All endpoints respond with correct status codes
API documentation is accurate and complete
Error responses are consistent and informative
api.suggested_must_use: OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, proper HTTP methods and status codes, request validation, structured logging
api.suggested_must_avoid: SQL injection, exposing stack traces in production, missing authentication on protected routes, N+1 query problems

browser_extension.name: Browser Extension
browser_extension.description: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge browser extension
suggested_criteria: Content scripts work on target pages
Popup and options UI work correctly
browser_extension.suggested_must_use: Manifest V3 (Chrome), minimal permission scoping, content security policy, proper message passing
browser_extension.suggested_must_avoid: Excessive permissions, remote code execution, data collection without consent, blocking the main thread

desktop_app.name: Desktop Application
suggested_criteria: System integration works (tray, notifications, file associations)
Application handles multiple monitors and DPI scaling
desktop_app.suggested_must_use: Native platform conventions, proper window lifecycle, system theme support, accessible UI
desktop_app.suggested_must_avoid: Excessive resource usage, blocking UI thread, platform-specific code without abstraction

mobile_app.name: Mobile Application
mobile_app.description: iOS, Android, or cross-platform mobile app
suggested_criteria: UI renders correctly across screen sizes
Data persists correctly across app restarts
mobile_app.suggested_must_use: Platform design guidelines (HIG/Material), responsive layouts, proper lifecycle handling, accessibility
mobile_app.suggested_must_avoid: Blocking main/UI thread, excessive battery/memory usage, hardcoded dimensions, ignoring safe areas

cli_tool.name: CLI Tool
suggested_criteria: Help text is accurate and complete
Error messages are clear and actionable

data_science.name: Data Science / ML
data_science.description: Data analysis, machine learning, or AI project
data_science.suggested_must_avoid: Absolute paths to data, training on test data

automation_script.name: Automation Script
automation_script.description: Scripts for task automation and batch processing
automation_script.suggested_must_avoid: Destructive operations without confirmation, hardcoded secrets

devops.name: DevOps / Infrastructure
devops.description: Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, and cloud automation
devops.suggested_must_use: Infrastructure as Code, version control for configs, secret management (Vault, etc.), least privilege IAM
devops.suggested_must_avoid: Hardcoded credentials, manual configuration drift, single points of failure, over-provisioned resources

bot.name: Chat Bot / Integration
bot.description: Discord, Slack, Telegram, or other chat platform bot
bot.suggested_must_use: Command framework, proper rate limit handling, graceful shutdown, logging, /help command
bot.suggested_must_avoid: Blocking event loop, tokens in source code, excessive API calls, ignoring platform ToS

library.name: Library / Package
library.description: Reusable library or package for any language
suggested_criteria: Unit tests pass with good coverage
Package installs correctly via package manager
Type definitions are complete and accurate
README and docs are clear and complete
library.suggested_must_use: Type hints/definitions, docstrings, semantic versioning, proper package manifest
library.suggested_must_avoid: Breaking changes without major version bump, circular dependencies, excessive dependencies

plugin.name: Plugin / Extension
plugin.description: Plugin or extension for an existing application
suggested_criteria: Plugin integrates with host API correctly
plugin.suggested_must_use: Host application's API conventions, proper lifecycle hooks, settings persistence, error boundaries
plugin.suggested_must_avoid: Global namespace pollution, modifying host internals, excessive resource usage, breaking other plugins

microservice.name: Microservice
suggested_criteria: Service starts and responds to health checks
Logging and metrics are properly configured
microservice.suggested_must_use: Health check endpoints, structured logging, environment variables for config
microservice.suggested_must_avoid: Storing state locally, hardcoded service URLs

excel_sheets.name: Excel / Sheets Template
excel_sheets.description: Spreadsheet-based applications with macros, formulas, and automation
excel_sheets.languages: VBA, Power Query (M), Google Apps Script, Python, LibreOffice Basic
suggested_criteria: Data validation rules work as expected
Large datasets perform within acceptable time
Error handling provides clear user feedback
excel_sheets.suggested_must_use: Named ranges, data validation, error handling in formulas (IFERROR), clear documentation/instructions sheet
excel_sheets.suggested_must_avoid: Volatile functions unnecessarily (INDIRECT, OFFSET), circular references, hardcoded ranges in macros, unprotected sensitive data

documentation.name: Documentation Site
documentation.description: Technical documentation, API docs, or knowledge base
suggested_criteria: Code examples are accurate and tested
documentation.suggested_must_use: Consistent formatting, clear heading hierarchy, working links, code syntax highlighting, table of contents
documentation.suggested_must_avoid: Outdated information, broken links, untested code examples, inconsistent terminology, missing search

game.name: Game Development
game.description: Video game or interactive entertainment project
suggested_criteria: Player input is responsive and accurate
Game state saves and loads correctly
Audio plays correctly and synchronizes with visuals
game.suggested_must_use: Delta time for frame-independent movement, asset management, input abstraction layer
game.suggested_must_avoid: Frame-rate dependent physics, blocking operations in game loop, memory leaks in asset loading

shader_creative.name: Shader / Creative Coding
shader_creative.description: Graphics programming, shaders, generative art, or creative coding
shader_creative.languages: GLSL, HLSL, WGSL, JavaScript, Python, Processing
shader_creative.suggested_must_use: GPU-efficient algorithms, proper uniform handling, responsive canvas sizing, requestAnimationFrame
shader_creative.suggested_must_avoid: Infinite loops in shaders, excessive texture samples, division by zero, GPU memory leaks

os_development.name: OS / Systems Development
os_development.description: Operating system, kernel, driver, or low-level systems programming
suggested_criteria: Kernel boots successfully on target hardware/emulator
Memory management operates correctly without leaks
Interrupt handlers respond within timing requirements
Hardware drivers initialize and operate properly
os_development.suggested_must_use: Memory-safe patterns, proper synchronization primitives, hardware abstraction layers
os_development.suggested_must_avoid: Undefined behavior, unhandled interrupts, unbounded loops in kernel space, memory corruption

embedded.name: Embedded / Maker
embedded.description: Arduino, Raspberry Pi, Jetson, ESP32, or other dev board projects
embedded.languages: C, C++ (Arduino), Python, MicroPython, CircuitPython, Rust (embedded-hal)
suggested_criteria: Sensor readings are accurate within tolerance
Communication protocols work reliably (I2C, SPI, UART, BLE, WiFi)
AI inference runs within latency/memory targets (if applicable)
embedded.suggested_must_use: Watchdog timers, proper pin initialization, interrupt-safe code, hardware abstraction layers, RTOS tasks for concurrency
embedded.suggested_must_avoid: Blocking delays in critical loops, floating/uninitialized inputs, unbounded memory allocation, ignoring hardware errata, busy-waiting when DMA/interrupts available, baud rate mismatches

blockchain.name: Blockchain / DeFi
blockchain.description: Cryptocurrency, smart contracts, or decentralized application development
blockchain.suggested_must_use: Audited libraries (OpenZeppelin), comprehensive test coverage, formal verification where possible
blockchain.suggested_must_avoid: Reentrancy patterns, unchecked external calls, floating pragma versions, storing sensitive data on-chain

web.name: Web & Internet
web.description: Websites, web applications, APIs, and browser extensions

automation.name: Automation & Infrastructure
automation.description: Scripts, DevOps, bots, and infrastructure as code

systems.name: Systems & Hardware
systems.description: OS development, embedded systems, and blockchain
